description: Second attempt of the 5 fig3b_sushi butterfly_reference runs (seeds 0-4). Attempt 1 trained to the end but failed at boson sampling: Perceval rejects the non-unitary trained U (D3). Corrective change: runner marks unitarity_error > 1e-8 as not deployable and skips model sampling; all other metrics written.
metric: primary: sample_metrics.<model>.walsh_mmd (same kernel operators for every model); also test_mmd_estimator (paper protocol) and gaussian_mmd_raw/binarized for Gaussian kernels
tie_rule: differences within one pooled std are reported as not separated
